question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
-- Get all unique drivers who meet the criteria
WITH driver_season_races AS (
    SELECT 
        rc.year,
        res.driver_id,
        res.constructor_id,
        rc.round,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.year, res.driver_id ORDER BY rc.round) AS rn_first,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.year, res.driver_id ORDER BY rc.round DESC) AS rn_last
    FROM results res
    JOIN races rc ON res.race_id = rc.race_id
    WHERE rc.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS total_rounds,
        MIN(CASE WHEN rn_first = 1 THEN constructor_id END) AS first_constructor_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN rn_last = 1 THEN constructor_id END) AS last_constructor_id
    FROM driver_season_races
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    d.driver_id,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.nationality
FROM first_last fl
JOIN drivers d ON fl.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE fl.total_rounds >= 2 
  AND fl.first_constructor_id = fl.last_constructor_id
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
